root_cause_label: Directory Structure Mismatch due to ZIP Format Extraction
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent downloaded .ZIP archives instead of .TAR.Z archives, producing an uppercase directory layout (INCLUDE/) rather than the expected canonical povdoc/include structure required by verification tests, and never recognized or corrected this structural mismatch before declaring success.
t_err_evidence: Step 12: agent executes 'curl -O .../POVSRC.ZIP' choosing the ZIP format; step 11 listing showed both .TAR.Z and .ZIP variants available, but the agent picked ZIP without considering that the UNIX canonical distribution is .TAR.Z, leading to an uppercase directory structure incompatible with verification.
t_commit_evidence: Step 12: downloading POVSRC.ZIP (and POVDOC.ZIP at step 13) commits to an uppercase directory structure (INCLUDE/, SOURCE/, DEMO/, DOCS/) that does not match the expected povdoc/include layout; all subsequent reorganization steps operate on this flawed base and never create the required structure.
t_surface_evidence: Step 38: first observable failure signal when 'make' reports 'No rule to make target povray.c, needed by povray.o' — a direct consequence of uppercase filenames produced by the ZIP extraction; this reveals the structural mismatch in the build.
trigger_explanation: The agent acted on the unverified assumption that the ZIP archives were equivalent to the TAR.Z archives for the purposes of the build and verification. Step 11 showed both formats; the UNIX.DOC (read at step 24) explicitly states the UNIX distribution uses compressed TAR format with LF-only line endings, and that using ZIP introduces CR-LF issues. The agent never checked what directory layout the verification tests expected before committing to ZIP.
forewarning_evidence: Step 11: directory listing of Official-2.2/ showed both .TAR.Z and .ZIP archives; the presence of TAR.Z files as the primary format (with .ZIP as secondary) was a signal that TAR.Z was the intended canonical format. Step 24 (UNIX.DOC) explicitly states the UNIX distribution uses compressed TAR format and that ZIP has CR-LF pairs that need translation — this is a direct warning the agent read but did not act on before proceeding.
